name: Space Love!
source:
A sci-fi comedy parody of what most people think of when they think of visual novels.

Features:
* Multiple endings!
* Real-time emotions!
* Not really!
* SPACE!!!!
* Possibility of robot love!

[Edited from [url=http://www.bardinelli.com/?p=3012]official site[/url]]
translation:
这是一部科幻喜剧，模仿了大多数人在想到视觉小说时的想法。

特点：
* 多个结局！
* 实时情绪！
* 并不真地！
* 空间！！！！
* 机器人爱情的可能性！

[编辑自[url=http://www.bardinelli.com/?p=3012]官方网站[/url]]
